settings.heading: Settings
settings.intro: Saved in .env in the project folder and applied right away. Running downloads keep their target folder.
settings.sleep_note: 0 = no pause. Helps against the YouTube bot check (randomly between n and 2n seconds).
settings.auth_heading: YouTube sign-in (against “Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot”)
settings.auth_intro: Optional. Only used when YouTube asks for a bot check – yt-album-dl then repeats the request with these cookies and downloads with sign-in for one hour, then without it again. Recommendation: use a secondary account – otherwise YouTube can link the downloads to your own account. Guide: exporting cookies (German)
settings.cookie_file_note: Export it on youtube.com with a browser extension such as “Get cookies.txt LOCALLY”. The most reliable way under WSL.
settings.cookie_browser_note: The browser in which you are signed in to YouTube. Under WSL only Firefox with the path to the Windows profile works; Chrome/Edge encrypt their cookies.
album.reset_hint: Reset the album fields, tracks and boundaries to the detected result

hist.file_missing: The file no longer exists at this location.
hist.clear_confirm: Delete the whole history? The downloaded files are kept.
settings.language_note: Applies to the interface and messages; the page reloads afterwards. Folder and tag names in the music library (e.g. “Unbekannt”, “Singles”) stay as they are.
